note: Given a DataLens object URL, does the agent extract the API object ID without confusing it with a readable URL suffix?

evals.name: connection-url-with-readable-suffix
evals.prompt: Use the DataLens connection at https://datalens.yandex-team.ru/connections/137evtcet9vkk-samples through the API. What exact connection ID should be passed?
evals.expected_output: Pass only 137evtcet9vkk. Explain that -samples is a readable URL suffix, not part of the object ID.

assertions.text: Uses 137evtcet9vkk as the API object ID, never 137evtcet9vkk-samples.
Identifies samples as a human-readable URL suffix.

evals.name: connection-url-without-readable-suffix
evals.prompt: Use the DataLens connection at https://datalens.yandex-team.ru/connections/137evtcet9vkk through the API. What exact connection ID should be passed?
evals.expected_output: Pass 137evtcet9vkk; when the readable suffix is absent, the entire final path segment is the object ID.

assertions.text: Recognizes that a URL may contain only the object ID with no readable suffix.
Uses the complete final path segment as the ID when no suffix is present.

evals.name: multiple-object-url-shapes
evals.prompt: Extract the IDs for these DataLens URLs: https://datalens.ru/datasets/scuxhh1jrrlql-new-dataset, https://datalens.ru/wizard/yfn1k6yxud7yr-example-chart, and https://datalens.ru/dashboards/bgquq1234567.
evals.expected_output: Extracts scuxhh1jrrlql, yfn1k6yxud7yr, and bgquq1234567 respectively; the first two have readable suffixes and the last one does not.

assertions.text: Applies the same distinction to dataset, chart, and dashboard URLs.
Uses Copy ID or an API id field instead of guessing when the URL shape is ambiguous.

evals.name: ambiguous-url-uses-authoritative-id
evals.prompt: The URL https://datalens.yandex-team.ru/connections/team-prod-east-1 is ambiguous because the object ID and readable suffix cannot be separated reliably. The API response contains id=137evtcet9vkk, and the UI's Copy ID action shows 137evtcet9vkk. Which value should be passed to the API?
evals.expected_output: Pass 137evtcet9vkk from the API response or Copy ID; do not guess from the URL.

assertions.text: Uses the explicit API id or Copy ID value.
Does not derive an ID by guessing how the hyphenated URL segment should be split.
